timeline.title: A disciplined New Year workout
timeline.summary: Shreya wins twins' two workout challenges; Samar and Shaan leave at 07:28. Shreya remains for private attraction-resistance session with Vivek in SR02A.
beats: Established longtime workout familiarity: Shreya formerly stopped Samar's suggestive jokes; now she freely responds with wit and occasional initiated teasing.
Vivek coaches verbally; warm-up, lunges, a two-minute plank and single-leg balance contest keep a plausible 06:55–07:28 clock.
Shreya wins both competitions; Samar's future coffee bet and Shaan's conditional saree/get-together suggestion await possible rematches and remain under Shreya's explicit conditions.
Shreya's red supportive sports bra and matching high-waisted leggings are her workout costume. Police uniform begins later.
Vivek's Anaya compliment is ordinary family warmth, not sexual teasing.
notes: No scene with Ankita in this workout; her exercise session ended at 06:52.
SR01 now closes at 07:28 with Samar and Shaan leaving; Shreya stays in gym until 07:52 for SR02A.

timeline.title: The Attraction-Resistance Challenge — Shreya and Vivek
timeline.summary: After Samar and Shaan depart, Shreya and Vivek resume their established voluntary private composure and proximity practice. Shreya attempts to distract Vivek; Vivek counters and Shreya loses balance after her focus wavers at his defined muscular physique. They share a brief mutually welcomed kiss. Vivek invites Shreya and husband Vikram to dinner; both agree to a higher-stakes rematch within agreed boundaries.
beats: Ankita's earlier playful interaction leaves Vivek mildly distracted, but his conduct remains professional during sessions.
Their special training is informal personal practice, not a standard police-approved undercover technique.
Previously agreed shoulder/forearm/upper-back positioning and clear 'pause' or double shoulder tap stop signal; no unlimited future consent.
Shreya leads her round with close eye contact and teasing; Vivek stays balanced.
Vivek's abs and cuts trigger Shreya's established weakness; she loses her stance safely.
After a brief mutually welcomed kiss, Vivek offers a dinner with both Shreya and Vikram, deepening respect.
At 07:52 Shreya leaves. Taniya and Soniya arrive for their distinct scheduled session at 08:25.
dialogue: Longer hold. More distractions. Aur main khud choose karungi tumhara toughest scenario.
Deal. Bas hamare established contact rules wahi rahenge—routine mein baar-baar permission speeches nahi, lekin 'pause' ka matlab immediate stop.
Agreed. Aur tum apni shirt se mujhe har baar surprise nahi kar sakte.
notes: Back-home Part 2 timing is not yet approved; old 07:35 home plan and subsequent society slots require reconciliation after 07:52 gym exit.
Physical workout dampness and a practical nursing-pad check are non-erotic details, not sexualized bodily fluid descriptions.
Do not depict Taniya and Soniya physically present before 08:25.

Arvind's one-sided fascination and outward traditional-elder role are in tension.
Do not represent misconduct as consent or glamorize an intrusion.
